candidates.statement: Payment service returns 503 on /v1/authorizations (and /readyz), causing order's POST /v1/orders to fail with 502 and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment logs show 503 on /readyz too, suggesting payment is unhealthy/unready rather than a pure application 500; exact payment-side fault not established.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory reservation succeeding (200) while payment authorization returns 503, propagating as order 502 and gateway checkout 502. Payment logs confirm repeated 503s on /v1/authorizations and /readyz. Root cause localized to payment unavailability; specific payment fault requires further evidence.
